player_prompt.intro:
Inwe Player {player_id}. Inwe uchiwo gi ludo mar Memory Game.
Dhumo lako ni kuongo mak wuod ang'wen mar karata kodi kodi nyingi kuliko jatelo lako.
Ka wakati wuod inwe, tich wuod karata abiri kodi kaweyo gi nambari mar safu na safu wuod karata achiel na karata ariri mtawali kama '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo karata achiel iko safu 0 na safu 1, na karata ariri iko safu 1 na safu 0.
Ka karata abiri gi ongo, inwe udhuru akinyi na karata kagawo gi kodi kaw gi moko. Ka ok ongo, karata kagawo gi kodi kaw gi chini, mfano '.'.
Ludo osie ka gi karata wuod ang'wen gi ongo wote.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Yo ma ok owinjore mar tugo. Jalo {player_id} ne ok odwoko gi yo mowinjore e kind brackets mag kare ariyo.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ok en gima owinjore. Jalo {player_id} noyiero kama ok ochuno ni obedie e ng'wechno.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ok en gima owinjore. Jalo {player_id} noyiero kad achiel nyadiriyo.
invalid_move.already_matched: Ok en gima owinjore. Jalo {player_id} oyiero achiel kata kad ariyo ma osepwodhore.

game_message.cards_match: Karata kagawo gi Player {player_id} kodi kaweyo gi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] ongo!
game_message.cards_no_match: Karata kagawo gi Player {player_id} ok ongo. Karata kodi kaweyo gi [{r1} {c1}] na [{r2} {c2}] gi {pos1} na {pos2} mtawali.

outcome.draw: Jothum ariyogo duto ne nigi namba maromre e tugo.
outcome.turn_limit: Wakati wa kaweyo karata osie. Ludo osie. Player 0 ochiek {score_0} alama, Player 1 ochiek {score_1} alama.
